facts.value: Globalization, growing complexity and rapid technological innovation are driving the demand for skilled industrial engineers. Arizona State University’s Master of Science in industrial engineering online combines physical, mathematical and social sciences to design systems that enhance quality of life and deliver meaningful improvements to sophisticated systems.
